rules.statement: A wife can sue in her own right to vindicate her share from the donee or a subsequent alienee, even if she is described as the 'irremovable attorney' by customary law.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is difficult to reconstruct the facts from a note in Muttukrishna, but there is a case noted by him at page 16 where a wife sued her husband and another in relation to property alleged to constitute acquired property of the spouses. ... The legal problems presented by the facts of this case were referred to Commissioners for report-an indication that the case was probably contested with care."
